{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count duplicate patient_id entries
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_count = (patient_id_counts > 1).sum()

total_rows = len(data)
unique_patient_count = len(patient_id_counts)

# Filter for treatment arm
treatment_arm = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

treatment_response_fraction = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Print only the numbers that will be in the evidence
print(duplicate_count)
print(total_rows)
print(unique_patient_count)
print(len(treatment_arm))
print(treatment_response_fraction)"}
